patch_list: Comprehensive privacy patch: silences the Ookla DevMetrics dispatcher so no event reaches Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics or Logcat. Does not affect speed-test functionality.
Stops Speedtest by Ookla's DevMetrics dispatcher (com.ookla.tools.logging) from forwarding info/watch/alarm events to Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and Logcat.
Removes ads and unlocks ad-free status in Speedtest by Ookla.
